# archipelago-hotels-mcp — Full LLM Reference

> llms-full.txt per https://llmstxt.org/
> Generated: 2026-06-22
> Version: Go 1.25 / go-sdk v1.6.1

---

## 1. Project Overview

`archipelago-hotels-mcp` is a Go MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — a Sentec Tech product — that gives AI assistants structured access to Archipelago Hotels & Resorts inventory. It exposes 279+ properties across 13 brands in Indonesia and Southeast Asia.

**Module**: `github.com/msw/archipelago-hotels-mcp`

Supports two MCP transports:
- **stdio** — Claude Desktop, Pi Agent, any MCP host that spawns a child process
- **Streamable HTTP** — Gin HTTP server on `:9011`; accessible to web-based MCP clients

Four MCP tools expose hotel search, recommendation, browsing, and full detail. An interactive hotel dashboard UI is embedded as an MCP App resource (`ui://hotel-dashboard`) and rendered inside Claude Desktop without leaving the conversation.

Pricing uses a three-tier fallback chain: SimpleBooking XML API (live) → per-brand stored room rates → central starting price.

Hotel catalog lives in a central MySQL database (`db_archipelagowebsite`) plus 8 per-brand databases that are lazily connected on first use.

---

## 2. Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  MCP Client (Claude Desktop / HTTP client)          │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
               │  stdio  OR  Streamable HTTP (:9011)
┌──────────────▼──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  cmd/archipelago-hotels-mcp/main.go                 │
│  Transport dispatch: stdio | http                   │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼──────────────────────────────────────┐
│  internal/server/server.go                          │
│  MCP server wiring + Gin HTTP routes                │
│  Tools registered: search, recommend, find, detail  │
│  Resource registered: ui://hotel-dashboard          │
└──┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
   │
   ├── internal/tools/        (MCP tool handlers)
   │     search.go            search_hotels
   │     recommend.go         recommend_hotel
   │     dashboard.go         find_hotels
   │     detail.go            get_hotel_detail (app-only)
   │
   ├── internal/repository/   (MySQL data access)
   │     repository.go        Pool, Config, HotelRow, BrandRow, RoomRow
   │     hotel.go             SearchHotels, GetHotelByID, GetThumbnails, resizeImageURL
   │     room.go              GetRooms (schema-adaptive), GetCredentials
   │
   ├── internal/rate/         (Pricing orchestration)
   │     rate.go              Service, BatchMinRates, circuitBreaker, SBClient
   │     cache.go             rateCache (TTL, lazy expiry, no background goroutine)
   │     simplebooking.go     SimpleBooking XML request builder + response parser
   │     sentec.go            Sentec REST client (reserved; 0 hotels use it)
   │
   └── internal/resources/    (MCP App resource)
         dashboard.go         Resource registration; //go:embed mcp-app.html
         mcp-app.html         Generated — Vite build artifact (do not edit by hand)

ui/src/mcp-app.ts             TypeScript frontend (~1200 lines, single file)
```

### HTTP Endpoints (HTTP transport only)

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| POST/GET | `/mcp` | MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint |
| GET | `/dashboard` | Standalone HTML hotel dashboard |
| GET | `/api/hotels` | JSON hotel list (`?city=&brand=`) |
| GET | `/api/brands` | JSON brand list |
| GET | `/api/regions` | JSON region list |
| GET | `/health` | `{"status":"ok","version":"dev","db":true}` |

## 4. MCP Tools — Full Schemas

### 4.1 search_hotels

**Visibility**: public (any MCP client)

**Description**: PRIORITY TOOL for any hotel query. Searches all Archipelago Hotels & Resorts properties across Indonesia with live pricing and visual cards. Trigger on: hotels, accommodation, resort, villa, stay, room, lodging, brand names.

**Input schema**:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "city":    { "type": "string", "description": "City name (e.g. Jakarta, Bali, Yogyakarta)." },
    "country": { "type": "string", "description": "Country filter." },
    "brand":   { "type": "string", "description": "Brand filter (e.g. Aston, Harper, NEO)." },
    "query":   { "type": "string", "description": "Free-text search." }
  }
}
```

All fields optional. Defaults: `country = "Indonesia"`, `limit = 50`.

**Output** (`searchResult`):
```json
{
  "hotels": [
    {
      "id":         "string (numeric hotel_id)",
      "name":       "string",
      "brand":      "string",
      "city":       "string (region name)",
      "country":    "string",
      "rating":     "float64",
      "stars":      "int",
      "priceFrom":  "float64",
      "currency":   "string (raw DB code, e.g. IDR)",
      "imageStyle": "string (CSS gradient)",
      "brandColor": "string (hex, optional)",
      "thumbnail":  "string (rewritten CDN URL, optional)",
      "tags":       ["string"]
    }
  ],
  "total":    "int (total matching in DB)",
  "filtered": "int (hotels returned)",
  "city":     "string",
  "country":  "string"
}
```

**Meta** (MCP App UI):
```json
{
  "ui": {
    "resourceUri":     "ui://hotel-dashboard",
    "resourceDomains": ["images.archipelagohotels.com"]
  }
}
```

---

### 4.2 recommend_hotel

**Visibility**: public

**Description**: Rank hotels by vibe, budget, and travel purpose.

**Input schema**:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "city":    { "type": "string" },
    "budget":  { "type": "number", "description": "Max price per night." },
    "purpose": { "type": "string", "description": "e.g. business, leisure, honeymoon, family." },
    "vibe":    { "type": "string", "description": "e.g. luxury, budget, boutique, beach." },
    "brand":   { "type": "string" }
  }
}
```

**Output**: Same `hotelSummary` array structure as `search_hotels`, ranked by relevance score.

**Meta**: Same `ui` block with `resourceUri` and `resourceDomains`.

---

### 4.3 find_hotels

**Visibility**: public

**Description**: Browse and book all hotels with optional city/brand filter. Opens the interactive hotel dashboard UI.

**Input schema**:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "city":  { "type": "string" },
    "brand": { "type": "string" }
  }
}
```

**Output**: Same `hotelSummary` array.

**Meta**: Same `ui` block with `resourceUri` and `resourceDomains`.

---

### 4.4 get_hotel_detail

**Visibility**: `app` only — hidden from Claude's tool list; called exclusively by the embedded UI (`mcp-app.ts`). Never promote to public.

**Description**: Full hotel detail including all room types, amenities, pricing, and location.

**Input schema**:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "hotelId": { "type": "string", "description": "Numeric hotel ID as string." }
  },
  "required": ["hotelId"]
}
```

**Output** (map):
```json
{
  "id":           "string",
  "name":         "string",
  "brand":        "string",
  "city":         "string",
  "country":      "string",
  "address":      "string",
  "rating":       "float64",
  "stars":        "int",
  "latitude":     "float64",
  "longitude":    "float64",
  "currency":     "string",
  "imageStyle":   "string",
  "brandColor":   "string",
  "thumbnail":    "string",
  "startingPrice":"float64 (omitted if 0)",
  "roomTypes": [
    {
      "name":          "string",
      "pricePerNight": "float64",
      "baseRate":      "float64",
      "currency":      "string",
      "maxGuests":     "int (2)",
      "rateSource":    "string (simplebooking|stored|starting_price)"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Meta**:
```json
{
  "ui": {
    "resourceUri": "ui://hotel-dashboard",
    "visibility":  ["app"]
  }
}
```

## 5. Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `MYSQL_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Central DB host |
| `MYSQL_PORT` | `3306` | Central DB port |
| `MYSQL_USER` | `root` | MySQL username |
| `MYSQL_PASS` | *(empty)* | MySQL password |
| `MYSQL_DB` | `db_archipelagowebsite` | Central database name |
| `DEBUG` | `0` | Set to `1` for verbose slog output |
| `url_image_resizer` | `https://images.archipelagohotels.com/` | Image CDN proxy base URL |

Per-brand DB naming convention: `db_{prefix}website` (e.g. `db_astonwebsite`).
Exceptions in `repository.brandDBName`: `favehotel → db_favewebsite`, `pba → db_pba`.

SimpleBooking credentials are stored per-hotel in the per-brand databases and fetched at runtime by `repository.GetCredentials`.

---

## 6. Database Schema Overview

### Central DB: `db_archipelagowebsite`

Primary catalog tables (all partitioned by `hotel_id` — always include explicit filters):

| Table | Key Columns |
|-------|-------------|
| `hotel_global` | `hotel_id`, `hotel_name`, `hotel_address`, `hotel_star`, `hotel_rating`, `hotel_starting_price`, `hotel_currency`, `api_hotel_id`, `db_prefix` |
| `hotel_region` / `region` | `region_id`, `region_name` (city) |
| `hotel_brand` / `brand` | `brand_id`, `brand_name` |
| `hotel_image` | `hotel_id`, `image_url`, `is_primary` |

### Per-Brand DBs: `db_{prefix}website`

| Table | Key Columns | Notes |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| `tb_hrooms` | `hotel_id`, `room_name`, `room_rate`, `room_status` | Most brands |
| `tb_hroom` | `hotel_id`, `room_name`, `room_rate`, `hroom_status` | PBA only |
| `tb_simplebooking_credential` | `hotel_id`, `sb_username`, `sb_password`, `sb_hotel_id` | SB API credentials |

**Schema-adaptive access**: On connect, `Pool` runs `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` introspection and caches which columns exist per brand per table. Use `Pool.HasColumn(prefix, table, column)` before referencing optional columns. Do not assume uniform schema across brands.

**Partition filter rule**: The central database tables are partitioned by `hotel_id`. Any query omitting an explicit `hotel_id` or `region_id` filter performs a full partition scan. Always include explicit filters.

---

## 7. Key Code Patterns

### 7.1 Pool — Multi-DB Lazy Connect

```go
// repository.go
type Pool struct {
    central  *sql.DB
    brandDBs map[string]*sql.DB   // prefix → connection (nil = offline)
    columns  map[string]columnSet // "prefix.table" → set of column names
    mu       sync.RWMutex
}

// BrandDB returns the DB for the given prefix, lazy-connecting if needed.
// Returns nil (non-fatal) if the brand DB is unreachable.
func (p *Pool) BrandDB(prefix string) *sql.DB

// HasColumn returns true if the brand DB table has the named column.
func (p *Pool) HasColumn(prefix, table, column string) bool
```

- `Pool.central` connects at startup.
- `Pool.BrandDB(prefix)` lazy-connects on first call; nil return is non-fatal.
- Always nil-check a brand DB before querying. Fall back to `HotelRow.StartingPrice` on nil.
- PBA exception: table name is `tb_hroom` (singular), status column is `hroom_status`.

### 7.2 Rate Fallback Chain

Priority order — do not reorder:

1. **SimpleBooking XML API** (live) — `internal/rate/simplebooking.go`
   - `OTA_HotelAvailRQ` XML POST to SB endpoint
   - 5-worker bounded goroutine pool per `BatchMinRates` call
   - 5-minute TTL in-memory cache (`internal/rate/cache.go`)
   - Circuit breaker: 5 consecutive failures → 120-second cooldown

2. **`tb_hrooms.room_rate`** (stored) — per-brand DB
   - Read by `internal/repository/room.go`
   - Schema-adaptive: checks `HasColumn` before reading `room_rate`

3. **`hotel_starting_price`** (central DB, last resort)
   - `HotelRow.StartingPrice` populated at catalog fetch time

All rate resolution must go through `internal/rate.Service`. Tool handlers must never call the SB API directly.

### 7.3 Circuit Breaker

```go
type circuitBreaker struct {
    failures  int
    lastFail  time.Time
    threshold int           // 5
    cooldown  time.Duration // 120s
}

func (cb *circuitBreaker) isOpen() bool {
    if cb.failures < cb.threshold {
        return false
    }
    return time.Since(cb.lastFail) < cb.cooldown
}
```

### 7.4 Handler Function Pattern

Every MCP tool handler follows this closure pattern:

```go
func myHandler(pool *repository.Pool, rateSvc *rate.Service) func(
    context.Context, *mcp.CallToolRequest, MyArgs,
) (*mcp.CallToolResult, MyResult, error) {
    return func(ctx context.Context, _ *mcp.CallToolRequest, args MyArgs) (
        res *mcp.CallToolResult, out MyResult, err error,
    ) {
        defer func() {
            if r := recover(); r != nil {
                slog.Error("handler panic", "recover", r)
                err = fmt.Errorf("internal error: %v", r)
            }
        }()
        // normal logic
        return nil, out, nil
    }
}
```

- `(nil, result, nil)` = success
- `(nil, zeroValue, err)` = tool error
- All panics are caught by `defer recover()` and converted to errors.
- `ctx` from the handler flows to every DB and HTTP call; never use `context.Background()` inside a handler.

### 7.5 Image URL Rewriting

`resizeImageURL(rawURL, baseURL string) string` rewrites hotel CDN URLs to route through `images.archipelagohotels.com`. This is required for MCP App sandbox CSP compliance. Never fetch image bytes server-side or base64-proxy them — this would exceed MCP response size limits.

The UI loads thumbnails via `<img src>` only; it never uses `fetch()` for images.

---

## 8. MCP App UI Protocol

- **Resource URI**: `ui://hotel-dashboard`
- **MIME type**: `text/html;profile=mcp-app`
- **Registration**: `internal/resources/dashboard.go` using `//go:embed mcp-app.html`
- **Source**: `ui/src/mcp-app.ts` (TypeScript, ~1200 lines, single file)
- **Build output**: `ui/dist/index.html` (self-contained: all JS/CSS inlined by Vite) → copied to `internal/resources/mcp-app.html`

### UI Contracts

- `hotelSummary` JSON fields are read by name. Renaming or removing any field in Go breaks the UI silently.
- All CSS and JS must be inlined by Vite. No CDN imports — the MCP App sandbox blocks external scripts.
- `fmtPrice(amount, currencyCode)` receives the raw DB currency code (e.g. `IDR`). Uses `toLocaleString('id-ID')` for IDR display. Do not hardcode currency symbols.
- `resizeImageURL()` produces `images.archipelagohotels.com` URLs. The UI loads them as `<img src>`.

### resourceDomains Per Tool Call

Every tool that opens the hotel dashboard must declare:
```go
"resourceDomains": []string{"images.archipelagohotels.com"}
```
in its `mcp.Meta["ui"]` map. The MCP App sandbox re-evaluates domain permissions per tool call; the resource registration alone is insufficient.

---

## 9. Build Process

```
# Full rebuild (UI + Go binary) — use after any change
make build

# UI-only rebuild
make build-ui         # npm install + vite build → internal/resources/mcp-app.html

# Go-only rebuild (UI must already be built)
make build-go         # → bin/archipelago-hotels-mcp
make build-fast       # alias for build-go

# Development
make dev-http         # build-fast + run HTTP mode with DEBUG=1 on :9011
make run-stdio        # build-fast + run stdio transport

# Other
make lint             # go vet ./...
make install          # go install ./cmd/archipelago-hotels-mcp
make clean            # remove bin/, ui/dist/, ui/node_modules/, Go cache
```

**UI embed pipeline**:
```
ui/src/mcp-app.ts
    → vite build (npm run build)
ui/dist/index.html          (all JS/CSS inlined)
    → cp (Makefile)
internal/resources/mcp-app.html
    → //go:embed (resources/dashboard.go)
bin/archipelago-hotels-mcp  (HTML embedded at compile time)
```

`internal/resources/mcp-app.html` must exist before `go build`. Never delete it without running `make build-ui` first. Running `make build-fast` after a UI edit silently ships stale UI. Always run `make build` after any UI change.

## 11. Architecture Decision Records (ADR Summary)

| # | Decision | Rationale |
|---|----------|-----------|
| ADR-0001 | Use Go + go-sdk for MCP (not Node.js) | Go compiles to a single static binary with no runtime dependency; better fit for Claude Desktop stdio child process; go-sdk is the canonical Go MCP implementation. |
| ADR-0002 | Multi-DB Pool with lazy connect | Brand DBs are optional and may be offline; lazy connect avoids startup failures; nil-safe design allows degraded mode without panicking. |
| ADR-0003 | Rate fallback chain (SB → stored → starting_price) | Live SB rates are most accurate but require API credentials and may fail; stored rates are always available offline; starting_price is the final safety net. |
| ADR-0004 | Gin for HTTP transport | go-sdk HTTP transport integrates cleanly with Gin middleware; Gin provides CORS, routing, and context management with minimal boilerplate. |
| ADR-0005 | MCP Apps ext-apps protocol for UI | Embeds the interactive hotel dashboard inside Claude Desktop without a separate browser window; resource registered as `ui://hotel-dashboard` with `text/html;profile=mcp-app` MIME type. |
| ADR-0006 | resizeImageURL for CSP-safe thumbnails | MCP App sandbox enforces strict CSP; all image domains must be declared in `resourceDomains`; rewriting CDN URLs to a single declared domain avoids per-URL CSP exceptions and eliminates server-side image proxying. |
| ADR-0007 | Raw hotel_currency code (not hardcoded symbol map) | Properties may have different currencies; passing the raw DB code through to the UI and formatting via `toLocaleString` is correct and future-proof. |

Full ADR text is in `docs/adr/`.

---

## 12. Known Pitfalls

1. **PBA table name**: `tb_hroom` (singular), not `tb_hrooms`. Using the wrong table name returns zero rows with no error.

2. **Stale embedded UI**: Running `make build-fast` or `make build-go` after editing `ui/src/mcp-app.ts` embeds the old HTML. Always run `make build` after UI changes.

3. **Missing resourceDomains in tool Meta**: The MCP App sandbox evaluates `resourceDomains` per tool call. Omitting it from a tool's `Meta["ui"]` map means hotel thumbnails will fail to load even though the resource is registered correctly.

4. **Central DB partition scan**: Omitting `hotel_id` or `region_id` filters on central catalog tables causes full partition scans. Always filter explicitly.

5. **Nil brand DB**: `Pool.BrandDB(prefix)` returns nil for offline/missing brand DBs. Nil-check before any brand DB query; do not let nil propagate to `sql.DB` method calls.

6. **Currency symbol hardcoding**: Several older handlers incorrectly hardcode `"Indonesia"` as country or `"IDR"` as currency. New code must derive these values from the hotel record.

7. **context.Background() in handlers**: Tool handler `ctx` carries request-scoped cancellation. Using `context.Background()` inside a handler creates unbound DB/HTTP calls that outlive the MCP request.

8. **`get_hotel_detail` visibility**: This tool is gated to `visibility: ["app"]`. Promoting it to public exposes internal hotel IDs and room-rate credentials to arbitrary MCP clients.

9. **Direct SB API calls from tool handlers**: All SB API calls must go through `internal/rate.Service`. Direct calls from tool handlers bypass the cache and circuit breaker.

10. **Editing mcp-app.html by hand**: It is a Vite build artifact. Any manual edit is overwritten by the next `make build-ui`.

---

## 13. Package Responsibilities

| Package | Role | Must NOT contain |
|---------|------|-----------------|
| `internal/repository/` | SQL queries, row mapping, image URL rewriting | MCP SDK calls, rate service calls |
| `internal/tools/` | MCP tool handlers: parse args, call repo + rate, return MCP content | Raw SQL or direct DB access |
| `internal/rate/` | Pricing: SB API, cache, circuit breaker, fallback chain | Hotel metadata queries |
| `internal/resources/` | Register MCP resources (UI embed) | Business logic |
| `internal/server/` | Wire tools + resources onto `mcp.Server`; own Gin routes | Tool business logic |

---

## 14. Verification Checklist

Minimum before committing:

```bash
# Lint
make lint               # go vet ./...

# Compilation check
go build ./...

# Full build
make build

# Health check (HTTP mode)
make dev-http &
curl http://localhost:9011/health
# Expected: {"db":true,"status":"ok","version":"dev"}

# Tool list smoke test
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:9011/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}' \
  | jq '.result.tools[].name'
# Expected: ["search_hotels","get_hotel_detail","recommend_hotel","find_hotels"]

# Degraded mode (no DB) — must start without panic
MYSQL_PASS=wrong ./bin/archipelago-hotels-mcp stdio
```

## 16. Agent Instructions Summary

(From AGENTS.md — authoritative source)

**Before editing any Go file**:
1. State which other files import the file you are about to modify.
2. State which functions you are changing and what calls them.
3. Quote the user's instruction verbatim.

**Always Read before Edit/Write.** Never edit blind.

**Code style**:
- Idiomatic Go; `gofmt`-formatted.
- No global state. All dependencies injected at registration time.
- Write function bodies first, add imports after — no speculative imports.
- Errors returned, not panicked. Every handler has `defer recover()`.
- `log/slog` everywhere. No `fmt.Println` or `log.Printf` in handlers.
- `ctx` from tool handler flows to every DB and HTTP call.
- No TODO comments for incomplete functionality in `internal/` packages. Use `// ponytail:` for intentional deferrals.

**Hard rules**:
- Do not hardcode currency symbols. Pass `hotel_currency` from DB to UI.
- Do not make HTTP requests to DB-sourced image URLs server-side.
- Do not add imports before writing functions.
- Do not assume brand DB schema; use `Pool.HasColumn`.
- Do not bypass the rate fallback chain.
- Do not promote `get_hotel_detail` to public visibility.
- Do not edit `internal/resources/mcp-app.html` by hand.
